name: quinelings
description: Executable mathematical creatures with recoverable harmonic and color genomes

scripts.test: node verify.cjs && node verify-library.cjs && node verify-design.cjs && node audit.cjs && node verify-morphology.cjs
scripts.formal: quint typecheck spec/design.qnt && quint test spec/design.qnt --max-samples=100 --backend=typescript && quint run spec/design.qnt --invariant=safety --max-samples=1000 --max-steps=50 --seed=20261003 --backend=typescript --verbosity=1
scripts.formal:all: npm run formal:lean && npm run formal
